name: LLM content moderation for code-mixed content

mentions.name: LLM content moderation for code-mixed content
mentions.description: This project tests LLM-based content moderation on code-mixed content that is not typical pure English. The work centers on gathering data and tuning moderation policy, with moderation run using COPE from Zentropi.
mentions.problem: The moderated content is code-mixed rather than typical pure English content.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Testing out LLM based content moderation tools, but on code mixed content. Content is not typical pure english content. Mostly its been a journey in getting data and then fiddling with policy.

I'm using COPE from Zentropi to run my moderation https://zentropi.ai/
